messages:
anya: Heads-up: after enabling strict fncall validation for the beta slice we saw duplicate rejects and noisy per-route graphs. Looks like retries create new internal ids and validator rejects lack a stable request id.

jordan: can you paste an example? is it retry duplication or unrelated failures?

lee: quick snippet (redacted):
```
INFO proxy parent_req=abc-7 retry=abc-7-r1 -> validator
ERROR validator fncall_reject reason=missing_field validator_id=vld-12 route_id=r-us-3
```
lee: validator logs don't include the parent request id, so enricher can't dedupe.

telemetry-bot: alert: duplicate_rejects ratio high for beta in us-west.

anya: proposal: synth X-Req-Id at the edge if missing, propagate through retries. Validator should echo x_req_id in reject events. Enricher will join on x_req_id and emit fncall_reject_enriched with dedup_key=x_req_id.

jordan: add retry_parent_id too so we can group attempts. Also keep a 5-minute dedupe window in telemetry before finalizing counts.

billing-svc: billing currently charges per fncall_response; we need dedup_key or billing_flag on enriched events so we avoid double billing. Suggest billing_flag=deferred until dedupe window closes.

console-svc: UX: show "enrichment pending" status on route error timeline and collapse duplicates by dedup_key. Banner: "Counts are consolidating".

anya: rollout plan: edge synth + validator echo for beta slice, telemetry dry-run with 5m dedupe, billing dry-run, then flip billing to respect dedupe. Action items:
- Lee: implement X-Req-Id synth/propagation (ETA 8h)
- Jordan: patch validator to include x_req_id & retry_parent_id (ETA 6h)
- Telemetry: 5m dedupe + dry-run (ETA 24h)
- Billing: accept billing_flag and dry-run (ETA 48h)
- Console-svc: UI state for enrichment pending (ETA 48h)

anya: policy note: during the canary do not enforce quota on deferred rejects. We'll notify affected customers.

telemetry-bot: scheduled: enable request-id synth on beta slice at 2026-04-05T14:00Z.

jordan: include validator_version in enriched events for debugging.

anya: thanks — reconvene after telemetry dry-run results.
